what: Shared calendar for parents splitting weekends/custody. From analysis of 10k 'I wish there was an app' posts on Reddit/X: 214 people asked, 38 said they'd pay. Avoids robot-sounding tools; focuses on real co-parenting logistics.
why_us: High willingness to pay (38 explicit), repeated demand over 30 days, family/parenting niche with clear pain (coordination without conflict). Easy MVP with calendar sync + notifications.
revenue: Potential $5-15/mo per user; 38 ready-to-pay signals from one scan

what: Invoice reminders for freelancers that don't sound robotic. 171 asked, 44 would pay. Human-tone AI or templates for chasing payments without awkwardness.
why_us: Strong pay signals (44), freelancers are price-sensitive but hate bad UX on existing tools like FreshBooks. Recurring pain.

what: Menu scanner that flags allergens in any language. 96 asked, 21 would pay. Camera + AI OCR for restaurant menus, multi-lang allergen detection.
why_us: Travel/health niche, clear safety pain, willingness to pay indicated. Mobile-first AI wrapper potential.

what: Sales tools someone should build: Rotten Tomatoes for sales advice (guru scoring by quota), Carfax for job offers (how many reps held seat/hit quota), Zillow for territories, TurboTax for commissions, Find My for ghosted prospects, Rocket Money for unused sales stack.
why_us: 114 likes from sales pro, concrete list of high-pain B2B tools. Sales teams pay well for efficiency.

what: Way to mark replies as AI slop on X to improve experience. YC partner Aaron Epstein post.
why_us: 217 likes from influential user, clear platform pain. Could be feature or third-party tool/extension.
revenue: Potential freemium or X API based

what: reception.sh (AI receptionist?) crossed $700 MRR exactly one week after launch.
why_us: Fast traction example for AI micro-SaaS. 340 likes shows community interest in rapid revenue.

what: beehiiv crossed $3m MRR. $0-1M in 36 months, $1-2M in 16, $2-3M in 9 months. Now adding $100k MRR every ~2.5 weeks. Owned audiences key as social/search weakened by AI.
why_us: Large-scale newsletter/SaaS success story with acceleration data. Lessons on distribution flywheel.

what: AI analysis of 10k 'I wish there was an app' posts filtered to 3 viable paid ideas (calendar, invoices, allergens). Grok bot used to kill weak ideas.
why_us: Meta: method for finding demand gaps via AI scraping. Directly shows viable micro-SaaS from public complaints.
revenue: N/A (idea filter), but derived products potential $5-20/mo

why_us: Users seeking reliable AI builders; pain with existing no-code/AI tools. Opportunity for better reliability, credit transparency, or specialized wrappers.
